column1: # CodonPipe virulence discovery - Gene Ontology axes
# Edit freely: every row is validated against the live ontology at run time and
# obsolete or unknown terms are reported in the provenance report.
# axis            host_interaction = direct engagement with the host (Falkow postulate 2 is
#                 interpretable: disruption is expected to attenuate without a generic growth cost)
#                 core_process     = function required for growth in vitro, so a disruption
#                 phenotype cannot be attributed to host interaction
# weight          NOT APPLIED. The descendant closure is fetched in root-chunks, so a
#                 term cannot be attributed to the root that contributed it without
#                 re-fetching per root, which would invalidate the shipped offline cache.
#                 Each matched term currently contributes a flat 0.5, capped at three terms
#                 per axis. The column is retained as documentation of intended relative
#                 strength; to down-weight a broad root, disable it instead.
# enabled         1 to use the term, 0 to keep it on record but inactive
